$comment: CI-only SecretLoop configuration. The self-scan job copies this to .secretloop.json before scanning, so the tool does not fail its own build on the synthetic credentials that tests/fixtures.ts generates on purpose. This is deliberately NOT the project's user configuration: a developer running `secretloop scan` locally still scans tests/, which is what keeps the scanner honest about its own repository.
$comment_scope: Only the synthetic corpus is excluded. src/, .github/, and every other path stay in scope, so a real credential committed anywhere outside tests/ still fails CI.
